description_en: Modifies the storage performance of a PolarDB for MySQL cluster
name: ModifyDBClusterStoragePerformance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token and ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The provisioned read and write IOPS for the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1000 × Capacity - Baseline performance}.

Baseline performance = min{1,800 + 50 × Capacity, 50,000}.

This parameter is supported only when StorageType is set to ESSDAUTOPL.
parameters.help_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50,000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。

基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50000}。

当StorageType为ESSDAUTOPL时才支持该参数。
parameters.name: provisioned_iops

parameters.help_en:
The target storage type. Valid values for Enterprise Edition:
PSL5
PSL4

Valid values for Standard Edition:
ESSDPL0
ESSDPL1
ESSDPL2
ESSDPL3
ESSDAUTOPL

Upgrade and downgrade paths from the source storage type to the target storage type
Before you call this operation, you can call the DescribeDBClusterAttribute operation to query the current StorageType, and then select the target StorageType and ModifyType based on the current type.

| Cluster edition | Current type | Target StorageType | ModifyType |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Enterprise Edition | PSL4 | PSL5 | Upgrade |
| Standard Edition | ESSDPL0 | ESSDPL1, ESSDPL2, ESSDPL3, or ESSDAUTOPL | Upgrade |
| Standard Edition | ESSDPL1 | ESSDPL2, ESSDPL3, or ESSDAUTOPL | Upgrade |
| Standard Edition | ESSDPL2 | ESSDPL3 | Upgrade |
| Standard Edition | ESSDPL2 | ESSDPL1 or ESSDAUTOPL | Downgrade |
| Standard Edition | ESSDPL3 | ESSDPL1, ESSDPL2, or ESSDAUTOPL | Downgrade |

Enterprise Edition does not support downgrading from PSL5 to PSL4. Standard Edition does not support downgrading to ESSDPL0 or downgrading from ESSDPL1. ESSDAUTOPL does not support changes to other storage types. You can keep ESSDAUTOPL and only adjust the provisioned IOPS or I/O burst configurations. In-place changes across Enterprise Edition PSL and Standard Edition ESSD types are not supported. This table lists the verified paths. Specific requests must still meet the cluster edition, modification cooldown period, and IOPS limits
parameters.help_zh:
目标存储类型，企业版存储类型取值如下：
PSL5
PSL4

标准版存储类型取值如下：
ESSDPL0
ESSDPL1
ESSDPL2
ESSDPL3
ESSDAUTOPL

源存储类型到目标类型的变配路径
调用前可通过 DescribeDBClusterAttribute 查询当前 StorageType，并按当前类型选择目标 StorageType 和 ModifyType。

| 集群版本 | 当前类型 | 目标 StorageType | ModifyType |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 企业版 | PSL4 | PSL5 | Upgrade |
| 标准版 | ESSDPL0 | ESSDPL1、ESSDPL2、ESSDPL3、ESSDAUTOPL | Upgrade |
| 标准版 | ESSDPL1 | ESSDPL2、ESSDPL3、ESSDAUTOPL | Upgrade |
| 标准版 | ESSDPL2 | ESSDPL3 | Upgrade |
| 标准版 | ESSDPL2 | ESSDPL1、ESSDAUTOPL | Downgrade |
| 标准版 | ESSDPL3 | ESSDPL1、ESSDPL2、ESSDAUTOPL | Downgrade |

企业版不支持 PSL5 降为 PSL4。标准版不支持降配到 ESSDPL0，也不支持从 ESSDPL1 降配。ESSDAUTOPL 不支持变更为其他存储类型；可保持 ESSDAUTOPL，仅调整预置 IOPS 或 IO 突发配置。跨企业版 PSL 和标准版 ESSD 类型的原地变更不适用。本表列出已核实的路径；具体请求仍需满足集群类别、变配冷却期和 IOPS 限制
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the I/O performance burst feature for the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values:

true: enables the feature.
false: does not enable the feature. This is the default value.

This parameter is supported only when StorageType is set to ESSDAUTOPL
parameters.help_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘是否开启IO性能突发。取值：

true：开启
false：不开启（默认）

当StorageType为ESSDAUTOPL时才支持该参数
parameters.name: bursting_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The modification type. Valid values: 
Upgrade: upgrades the specifications.
Downgrade: downgrades the specifications
parameters.help_zh:
变更类型，取值范围如下： 
Upgrade：升级规格
Downgrade：降级规格
parameters.name: modify_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
true: uses coupons. This is the default value.
false: does not use coupons
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
true（默认）：使用优惠券。
false：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
parameters.name: promotion_code
